# GitHub Community Health Files

This directory contains the community health files for the Infra App project:

- [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - Our pledge to foster an open and welcoming environment
- [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) - How to contribute to this project
- [License](../LICENSE) - The MIT License for this project
- [Issue Templates](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/) - Templates for reporting bugs, requesting features, and asking questions
- [Pull Request Template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) - Template for submitting pull requests

These files help establish clear guidelines and expectations for community participation and contribution.
